message.content: {"label":"Positive","rationale":"The supplier delivered late, so the delay is material under the general rule (F1, C6). The customer caused the delay (F2), but where Clauses 3 and 1 both apply, Clause 3 takes precedence (S1); Clause 3 therefore entitles the customer to the penalty. The valid agreement and critical order also satisfy Clause 5 (F3, F4, C5).","source_ids":["F1","C6","F2","C1","C3","S1","F3","F4","C5","D1"]}
